#====项目纲要====
#【部署】Python 3.11+ 跨平台 Python 包，使用 flit_core 构建；安装后提供 sphinx-build、sphinx-quickstart、sphinx-apidoc、sphinx-autogen 命令，也可用 python -m sphinx；文档工程以源目录/conf.py 为输入，按 builder 写入输出目录并在 doctree 目录缓存环境。
#【系统】Sphinx 是把 reStructuredText 等文档源转换为 HTML、LaTeX/PDF、EPUB、手册页、纯文本等格式的可扩展文档生成器 | CLI 创建 Sphinx 应用，应用装载配置与扩展、建立 Project/BuildEnvironment、经注册表选择 Builder，并以事件、领域、指令、角色、变换和 writer 组成读取—解析—解析引用—写出流水线 | 保持扩展注册与事件契约、增量环境缓存语义、跨 builder 输出边界和配置兼容性。
#【架构】入口层(sphinx/__main__.py、sphinx/cmd/)解析命令并创建应用；核心层(sphinx/application.py、config.py、events.py、registry.py、project.py、environment/)协调扩展、项目发现、环境与构建阶段；语义层(directives/、domains/、roles.py、transforms/)建立并解析 Docutils 文档树；构建输出层(builders/、writers/、themes/、templates/、texinputs/)选择格式并渲染；ext/ 提供可选扩展；locale/ 与 util/ 提供本地化及共用设施；tests/ 以单元测试和完整文档工程夹具锁定行为。
#【数据流】命令行/嵌入调用 → Config 与扩展装载 → Project 查找源文件 → BuildEnvironment 读取、缓存并维护文档关系 → Builder 解析/变换 doctree、解析引用 → Writer/模板/静态资源生成目标格式；事件总线允许扩展在各阶段参与，失败构建删除环境缓存以强制下次重建。
#【整体规范】源码使用 Python 类型标注并以 py.typed 发布；配置、事件、领域对象、builder 名称和扩展 setup 是主要扩展面；第三方依赖与标准库不列入 Uses；文档名相对源目录、去除扩展名并统一使用正斜线，源文档采用 UTF-8，额外解析格式由扩展注册文件类型与后缀。
#纲要格式：文件名[标签]: Role:职责 | Uses:依赖 | API:对外契约 | Constraints:约束 ；文件名不带路径；四字段必填,无内容写-
#骨架规则：只有裸文件名没有纲要的行是尚未建立认知的文件,读取时顺便生成纲要并调用 ortg_update 提交
#目标规则：条目下一行 #目标: 是目标纲要(改完后应有的纲要,不写待核查事项)；#目标:删除 计划删除；#计划新建 文件尚不存在
#测试契约规则：被测试锁定的对外行为写成"必须保持 X(测试名)"并写清期望结果；只涉及一个文件的写进它的 Constraints,跨模块的登记进【契约】；需求与守护测试冲突时按证据裁决:需求点名该测试或说旧行为错→改测试,需求说测试权威/行为不变/只是迁移→保持,有命令与期望输出的验收例→按实跑结果,都没有→先求两全,不能两全按需求实现,并把选择与理由记进纲要
#契约规则：跨模块、不靠调用关系的约定(同一概念由多层共同实现、协议与消息格式、单位、兼容性、HTTP/WebSocket 路由与消息类型、配置键)在纲要头登记一行 #【契约】键：正文(正文写约定与守护测试,只写这一处)；每个参与文件在纲要行末尾加 | Keys:键(角色),… 声明它；路由、消息、事件、配置、环境变量类的键写成 route:/ws:/msg:/event:/topic:/cfg:/env: 加字面值
#===代码纲要规范===
#【标签】[C A B D… E] 重要度数字在前,其后层级、模块、特征(0到多个)、规模,空格分隔,每个是一个大写字母(模块可两个)
#A层级: E入口 C核心 S服务 D数据 I集成 U工具 T测试 B构建 X配置 O文档
#B模块: R运行核心 C配置 B构建输出 D领域标记 E扩展 H网页主题搜索 L本地化 U通用工具 T测试 O文档 P项目工程
#C重要度: 9核心 8高频 7业务 5常规 3辅助 1边缘
#D特征: V事件扩展 P解析语法 I国际化 W网页前端 F文件格式 X跨引用 S序列化
#E规模: L大>400 M中200-400 S小100-200 T微<100
#Constraints配额: C9≤2000字 C8≤1200字 C7-4≤500字 C3-1≤100字
#===代码纲要规范完毕===

#代码纲要

===/testbed/doc/usage/===
referencing.rst[9 O D X M]: Role:定义跨对象、任意标签、文档、下载资源、编号内容、词汇及任意目标的统一交叉引用语法与解析规则 | Uses:sphinx/domains/std/__init__.py(标准引用), sphinx/domains/(对象引用), sphinx/environment/collectors/asset.py(下载资源), sphinx/ext/intersphinx/(外部回退), doc/usage/domains/index.rst(领域角色) | API:ref、doc、download、numref、confval、envvar、token、keyword、option、term、any 角色；显式标题、!抑制链接、~缩短显示名修饰符 | Constraints:显式标签在全项目必须唯一且定义时以下划线开头、引用时省略；无章节/图表/表格标题紧随的普通标签必须使用显式链接文字；doc 路径大小写始终敏感，绝对路径相对源目录，省略标题时使用目标文档标题；download 仅 HTML 复制到带唯一哈希的 _downloads 子目录，应以 builder_html 条件隐藏其他输出的段落；numref 依赖 numfig，显式文本中的 %s/{number}/{name}分别替换编号或标题，numfig=False 时退化为标签/文字；any 先查标准目标与自定义对象，再遍历所有领域及 intersphinx，零个或多个匹配都警告。

===/testbed/doc/usage/domains/===
c.rst[9 O D P M]: Role:定义 C API 声明、作用域、匿名实体、别名、表达式与交叉引用的领域语法 | Uses:sphinx/domains/c/(解析与符号实现), doc/usage/restructuredtext/field-lists.rst(信息字段), doc/usage/configuration.rst(C领域配置), doc/usage/referencing.rst(引用修饰) | API:c:member/var/function/macro/struct/union/enum/enumerator/type/alias/namespace/namespace-push/namespace-pop 指令；c:member/data/var/func/macro/struct/union/enum/enumerator/type/any/expr/texpr 角色 | Constraints:C 函数签名按 C 语法解析且星号无需 reST 转义，信息字段的 type/rtype 按 c:expr 解析；single-line-parameter-list 局部覆盖 C 与全局签名行长；匿名结构/联合/枚举必须赋以 @ 开头的文档名，渲染为 [anonymous] 且嵌套引用可省略匿名段；alias 的 maxdepth=0 表示无限、默认1，noroot 要求0或至少2；namespace 重置栈且 NULL/0 回全局，namespace-push 相对追加完整 scope，namespace-pop 撤销最近一次 push 而非只去掉一个点分段，无 push 时回全局。
cpp.rst[9 O D P L]: Role:定义 C++ 声明、模板、概念、作用域、别名、表达式与精确交叉引用的领域语法 | Uses:sphinx/domains/cpp/(解析与符号实现), doc/usage/restructuredtext/field-lists.rst(信息字段), doc/usage/configuration.rst(C++领域配置), doc/usage/referencing.rst(引用语法) | API:cpp:class/struct/function/member/var/type/enum/enum-struct/enum-class/enumerator/union/concept/alias/namespace/namespace-push/namespace-pop 指令；cpp:any/class/struct/func/member/var/type/concept/enum/enumerator/expr/texpr 角色 | Constraints:所有声明可带 public/private/protected且支持模板，class与struct及member与var只在显示上不同；concept 必须恰有一个模板参数表且概念/requires 支持仍为实验性，不支持 requires 子句也不校验 template introduction 参数兼容性；匿名实体须赋 @ 名并显示为 [anonymous]，嵌套查找可省略它；alias 裸函数名列全部重载，完整签名只列精确重载，maxdepth=0 无限且 noroot 要求0或至少2；namespace 以 NULL/0/nullptr 回全局并重置栈，push 相对追加，pop 撤销最近一次 push；模板专门化的角色内容中 < 会被当显式标题语法，须转义或改用 expr/texpr；仅函数名或 f() 任取重载，完整函数声明精确匹配且不受 add_function_parentheses 影响；模板查找目前要求参数标识符字符串相同，部分特化引用不能省略模板参数表。
index.rst[8 O D P M]: Role:解释领域作为对象指令、角色与索引集合的模型，索引内建及第三方领域，并定义通用对象描述行为 | Uses:sphinx/domains/(领域实现), doc/extdev/domainapi.rst(扩展 API), doc/usage/referencing.rst(引用修饰), doc/usage/domains/python.rst(Python领域), doc/usage/domains/cpp.rst(C++领域) | API:default-domain 指令；领域指令通用 no-index、no-index-entry、no-contents-entry、no-typesetting 选项与旧别名 | Constraints:领域名作为 directive/role 前缀避免跨语言同名冲突；no-index 禁止引用目标并隐含不建可见索引项，no-index-entry 仅抑制索引，no-contents-entry 仅排除目录，no-typesetting 仍建立目标和索引但不渲染描述；并非每个领域指令都支持全部通用选项；续行签名须以反斜线连接；primary_domain 是全局默认，default-domain 只影响当前文件，未设置时默认为 py；旧无连字符选项名仅兼容保留。
javascript.rst[7 O D P S]: Role:定义 JavaScript 领域的模块、函数、方法、类、数据与属性对象标记及交叉引用 | Uses:sphinx/domains/javascript.py(领域实现), doc/usage/restructuredtext/field-lists.rst(参数字段语法), doc/usage/configuration.rst(签名折行配置) | API:js:module、js:function、js:method、js:class、js:data、js:attribute 指令；js:mod、js:func、js:meth、js:class、js:data、js:attr 角色 | Constraints:js:module 设置后续对象的模块上下文且默认创建可链接模块索引项，no-index 仅更新上下文；可选参数以方括号表示；single-line-parameter-list 局部覆盖 JavaScript 与全局最大签名行长配置。
mathematics.rst[3 O D T]: Role:定义 math 领域通过标签交叉引用带编号公式的角色 | Uses:sphinx/domains/math.py(领域实现) | API:math:numref 角色 | Constraints:引用目标必须是 math 指令通过 label 定义的公式标签。
python.rst[9 O D P L]: Role:定义 Python 模块、对象、签名、信息字段、类型别名及上下文感知交叉引用的领域语法 | Uses:sphinx/domains/python/(对象与注解实现), doc/usage/restructuredtext/field-lists.rst(字段语法), doc/usage/referencing.rst(引用修饰), doc/usage/configuration.rst(Python领域配置), sphinx/ext/autodoc/(meta字段消费者) | API:py:module/currentmodule/function/data/exception/class/attribute/property/type/method/staticmethod/classmethod/decorator/decoratormethod 指令；py:mod/func/deco/data/const/class/meth/attr/type/exc/obj 角色；param/type/raises/var/vartype/returns/rtype/meta 信息字段 | Constraints:module 建模块索引与引用目标，currentmodule 只改上下文；类成员宜嵌套在 class 中，否则名称须含类名；method 签名不列 self，decorator 签名表示 @ 使用形式而非接收被装饰对象的底层调用；type/value 指令选项中的 type 必须是有效 Python 注解表达式，不解析 reST 或“or/of”，联合用 |、容器用 []，这与信息字段 type 支持 or 和括号容器不同；canonical 对普通对象表示导入对象定义处，对 py:type 表示别名代表的类型；single-line 参数/类型参数选项局部覆盖 Python 与全局阈值；函数引用是否自动加括号由 add_function_parentheses 控制，deco 始终显示 @；短名按裸名、当前模块、当前模块加类顺序查找，前导点反转顺序并可后缀匹配，多匹配警告；~只缩短显示名且可与前导点组合。
restructuredtext.rst[7 O D P S]: Role:定义用于文档化 reStructuredText 指令、指令选项和角色的 rst 领域标记及引用方式 | Uses:sphinx/domains/rst.py(领域实现) | API:rst:directive、rst:directive:option、rst:role 指令；rst:dir 与 rst:role 角色 | Constraints:directive 可接收裸名或含“..”与“::”的实际语法；directive:option 应嵌套在所属 directive 下，带参数的选项名用冒号分隔并可用 type 描述值类型；rst:dir 以“指令名:选项名”引用选项。
standard.rst[7 O D P S]: Role:定义无显式领域前缀的命令行选项、配置值、环境变量、程序上下文与通用对象描述标记 | Uses:sphinx/domains/std/__init__.py(标准领域实现), sphinx/application.py(自定义对象类型注册), doc/usage/configuration.rst(选项占位符配置) | API:option、confval、envvar、program、describe/object 指令；option、confval、envvar 角色 | Constraints:add_object_type 注册的自定义对象归入标准领域；option 的参数占位符用尖括号，角色引用可带 =value、[=value] 或空格值；program 为后续 option 建立程序上下文且 None 重置，引用必须以程序名限定；confval 的 type/default 内容按 reStructuredText 解析；describe/object 只格式化而不创建索引或交叉引用目标。

===/testbed/sphinx/===
addnodes.py[9 D D P X I L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 在 Docutils 之上的可翻译目录树、对象签名、索引、条件内容、交叉引用及输出控制节点，并以内建扩展统一注册 | Uses:sphinx/application.py(节点注册接口), sphinx/environment/__init__.py(延迟引用解析), sphinx/transforms/post_transforms/__init__.py(签名节点回退), sphinx/writers/(节点输出消费者), sphinx/domains/(对象与引用节点生产者) | API:translatable；not_smartquotable；toctree；desc 与全部 desc_* 节点；SIG_ELEMENTS；versionmodified；seealso；productionlist/production；index；centered；acks；hlist/hlistcol；compact_paragraph；glossary；only；start_of_file；highlightlang；tabular_col_spec；pending_xref/pending_xref_condition；number_reference；download_reference；literal_emphasis/literal_strong；manpage；setup(app) | Constraints:translatable 节点必须先保留原消息、再应用译文且不得覆盖供最终 gettext 抽取的原文；多行 desc_signature 的子节点只能是 desc_signature_line，desc_content 必须是 desc 的末子节点；pending_xref 若含条件节点则只能含条件节点并在解析时恰选一个，condition='*' 保留作失败回退；第三方签名元素继承 desc_sig_element 默认不进入 SIG_ELEMENTS，只有显式 _sig_element=True 才加入并要求非 SphinxTranslator builder 处理；desc_classname 是 desc_addname 兼容别名。必须保持内建九类 desc_sig_* 自动登记，而未显式或显式 False 的子类不登记（test_desc_sig_element_nodes）。

===/testbed/sphinx/directives/===
__init__.py[9 C D P V M]: Role:定义领域对象描述、默认角色与默认领域的基础 reStructuredText 指令及对象说明变换事件 | Uses:sphinx/addnodes.py(对象描述节点), sphinx/util/docutils.py(SphinxDirective与角色注册), sphinx/util/docfields.py(说明字段变换), sphinx/environment/collectors/toctree.py(对象目录属性消费) | API:ObjectDescription 扩展基类；optional_int；default-role、default-domain、describe、object 指令；object-description-transform 事件；strip_signature_backslash 配置；setup(app) | Constraints:ObjectDescription 支持多行签名和反斜线续行，handle_signature 失败时退化为纯 desc_name且不建索引；同一说明块中重复对象名只首次加目标和索引。旧 noindex/noindexentry/nocontentsentry 映射到连字符新名并保留兼容节点属性；no-index、no-index-entry、no-contents-entry分别控制目标索引、索引条目与目录条目，no-typesetting 删除可见说明但必须汇集后代 ids 返回 target。内容允许章节标题，先调用 transform_content，再发 object-description-transform，最后转换 doc fields；before_content/after_content必须包围内容处理并清空当前对象名。对象目录只在 toc_object_entries 开启时记录 _toc_parts/_toc_name。default-role 无参数会注销默认角色，未知角色返回带原指令文本的错误；default-domain 名称转小写，未知值设置为None。

class CObject(ObjectDescription[ASTDeclaration]):
    """Description of a C language object."""

    option_spec: ClassVar[OptionSpec] = {
        'no-index-entry': directives.flag,
        'no-contents-entry': directives.flag,
        'no-typesetting': directives.flag,
        'noindexentry': directives.flag,
        'nocontentsentry': directives.flag,
        'single-line-parameter-list': directives.flag,
    }

    def _add_enumerator_to_parent(self, ast: ASTDeclaration) -> None:
        assert ast.objectType == 'enumerator'
        # find the parent, if it exists && is an enum
        #                  then add the name to the parent scope
        symbol = ast.symbol
        assert symbol
        assert symbol.ident is not None
        parent_symbol = symbol.parent
        assert parent_symbol
        if parent_symbol.parent is None:
            # TODO: we could warn, but it is somewhat equivalent to
            # enumeratorss, without the enum
            return  # no parent
        parent_decl = parent_symbol.declaration
        if parent_decl is None:
            # the parent is not explicitly declared
            # TODO: we could warn, but?
            return
        if parent_decl.objectType != 'enum':
            # TODO: maybe issue a warning, enumerators in non-enums is weird,
            # but it is somewhat equivalent to enumeratorss, without the enum
            return
        if parent_decl.directiveType != 'enum':
            return

        target_symbol = parent_symbol.parent
        s = target_symbol.find_identifier(
            symbol.ident, matchSelf=False, recurseInAnon=True, searchInSiblings=False
        )
        if s is not None:
            # something is already declared with that name
            return
        decl_clone = symbol.declaration.clone()
        decl_clone.enumeratorScopedSymbol = symbol
        Symbol(
            parent=target_symbol,
            ident=symbol.ident,
            declaration=decl_clone,
            docname=self.env.current_document.docname,
            line=self.get_source_info()[1],
        )

    def add_target_and_index(
        self, ast: ASTDeclaration, sig: str, signode: TextElement
    ) -> None:
        ids = []
        for i in range(1, _max_id + 1):
            try:
                id = ast.get_id(version=i)
                ids.append(id)
            except NoOldIdError:
                assert i < _max_id
        # let's keep the newest first
        ids.reverse()
        newest_id = ids[0]
        assert newest_id  # shouldn't be None

        name = ast.symbol.get_full_nested_name().get_display_string().lstrip('.')
        if newest_id not in self.state.document.ids:
            # always add the newest id
            assert newest_id
            signode['ids'].append(newest_id)
            # only add compatibility ids when there are no conflicts
            for id in ids[1:]:
                if not id:  # is None when the element didn't exist in that version
                    continue
                if id not in self.state.document.ids:
                    signode['ids'].append(id)

            self.state.document.note_explicit_target(signode)

        if 'no-index-entry' not in self.options:
            index_text = self.get_index_text(name)
            self.indexnode['entries'].append((
                'single',
                index_text,
                newest_id,
                '',
                None,
            ))

    @property
    def object_type(self) -> str:
        raise NotImplementedError

    @property
    def display_object_type(self) -> str:
        return self.object_type

    def get_index_text(self, name: str) -> str:
        return _('%s (C %s)') % (name, self.display_object_type)

    def parse_definition(self, parser: DefinitionParser) -> ASTDeclaration:
        return parser.parse_declaration(self.object_type, self.objtype)

    def describe_signature(
        self, signode: TextElement, ast: ASTDeclaration, options: dict[str, Any]
    ) -> None:
        ast.describe_signature(signode, 'lastIsName', self.env, options)

    def run(self) -> list[Node]:
        env = self.env
        if env.current_document.c_parent_symbol is None:
            root = env.domaindata['c']['root_symbol']
            env.current_document.c_parent_symbol = root
            env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = root.get_lookup_key()

        # When multiple declarations are made in the same directive
        # they need to know about each other to provide symbol lookup for function parameters.
        # We use last_symbol to store the latest added declaration in a directive.
        env.current_document.c_last_symbol = None
        return super().run()

    def handle_signature(self, sig: str, signode: TextElement) -> ASTDeclaration:
        parent_symbol: Symbol = self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol

        max_len = (
            self.config.c_maximum_signature_line_length
            or self.config.maximum_signature_line_length
            or 0
        )
        signode['multi_line_parameter_list'] = (
            'single-line-parameter-list' not in self.options
            and (len(sig) > max_len > 0)
        )

        parser = DefinitionParser(sig, location=signode, config=self.config)
        try:
            ast = self.parse_definition(parser)
            parser.assert_end()
        except DefinitionError as e:
            logger.warning(e, location=signode)
            # It is easier to assume some phony name than handling the error in
            # the possibly inner declarations.
            name = _make_phony_error_name()
            symbol = parent_symbol.add_name(name)
            self.env.current_document.c_last_symbol = symbol
            raise ValueError from e

        try:
            symbol = parent_symbol.add_declaration(
                ast,
                docname=self.env.current_document.docname,
                line=self.get_source_info()[1],
            )
            # append the new declaration to the sibling list
            assert symbol.siblingAbove is None
            assert symbol.siblingBelow is None
            symbol.siblingAbove = self.env.current_document.c_last_symbol
            if symbol.siblingAbove is not None:
                assert symbol.siblingAbove.siblingBelow is None
                symbol.siblingAbove.siblingBelow = symbol
            self.env.current_document.c_last_symbol = symbol
        except _DuplicateSymbolError as e:
            # Assume we are actually in the old symbol,
            # instead of the newly created duplicate.
            self.env.current_document.c_last_symbol = e.symbol
            msg = __(
                'Duplicate C declaration, also defined at %s:%s.\n'
                "Declaration is '.. c:%s:: %s'."
            )
            logger.warning(
                msg,
                e.symbol.docname,
                e.symbol.line,
                self.display_object_type,
                sig,
                location=signode,
                type='duplicate_declaration',
                subtype='c',
            )

        if ast.objectType == 'enumerator':
            self._add_enumerator_to_parent(ast)

        # note: handle_signature may be called multiple time per directive,
        # if it has multiple signatures, so don't mess with the original options.
        options = dict(self.options)
        self.describe_signature(signode, ast, options)
        return ast

    def before_content(self) -> None:
        last_symbol: Symbol = self.env.current_document.c_last_symbol
        assert last_symbol
        self.oldParentSymbol = self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol
        self.oldParentKey: LookupKey = self.env.ref_context['c:parent_key']
        self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol = last_symbol
        self.env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = last_symbol.get_lookup_key()

    def after_content(self) -> None:
        self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol = self.oldParentSymbol
        self.env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = self.oldParentKey

    def _object_hierarchy_parts(self, sig_node: desc_signature) -> tuple[str, ...]:
        last_symbol: Symbol = self.env.current_document.c_last_symbol
        return tuple(map(str, last_symbol.get_full_nested_name().names))

    def _toc_entry_name(self, sig_node: desc_signature) -> str:
        if not sig_node.get('_toc_parts'):
            return ''

        config = self.config
        objtype = sig_node.parent.get('objtype')
        if config.add_function_parentheses and (
            objtype in {'function', 'method'}
            or (objtype == 'macro' and '(' in sig_node.rawsource)
        ):
            parens = '()'
        else:
            parens = ''
        *parents, name = sig_node['_toc_parts']
        if config.toc_object_entries_show_parents == 'domain':
            return '::'.join((name + parens,))
        if config.toc_object_entries_show_parents == 'hide':
            return name + parens
        if config.toc_object_entries_show_parents == 'all':
            return '::'.join([*parents, name + parens])
        return ''

class CNamespaceObject(SphinxDirective):
    """This directive is just to tell Sphinx that we're documenting stuff in
    namespace foo.
    """

    has_content = False
    required_arguments = 1
    optional_arguments = 0
    final_argument_whitespace = True
    option_spec: ClassVar[OptionSpec] = {}

    def run(self) -> list[Node]:
        root_symbol = self.env.domaindata['c']['root_symbol']
        if self.arguments[0].strip() in {'NULL', '0', 'nullptr'}:
            symbol = root_symbol
            stack: list[Symbol] = []
        else:
            parser = DefinitionParser(
                self.arguments[0], location=self.get_location(), config=self.config
            )
            try:
                name = parser.parse_namespace_object()
                parser.assert_end()
            except DefinitionError as e:
                logger.warning(e, location=self.get_location())
                name = _make_phony_error_name()
            symbol = root_symbol.add_name(name)
            stack = [symbol]
        self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol = symbol
        self.env.current_document.c_namespace_stack = stack
        self.env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = symbol.get_lookup_key()
        return []


class CNamespacePushObject(SphinxDirective):

    option_spec: ClassVar[OptionSpec] = {}

    def run(self) -> list[Node]:
        if self.arguments[0].strip() in {'NULL', '0', 'nullptr'}:
            return []

        self.env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = symbol.get_lookup_key()

class CNamespacePopObject(SphinxDirective):
    has_content = False
    required_arguments = 0
    optional_arguments = 0
    final_argument_whitespace = True
    option_spec: ClassVar[OptionSpec] = {}

    def run(self) -> list[Node]:
        stack = self.env.current_document.c_namespace_stack
        if len(stack) == 0:
            logger.warning(
                'C namespace pop on empty stack. Defaulting to global scope.',
                location=self.get_location(),
            )
        else:
            stack.pop()
        if len(stack) > 0:
            symbol = stack[-1]
        else:
            symbol = self.env.domaindata['c']['root_symbol']
        self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol = symbol
        self.env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = symbol.get_lookup_key()
        return []


class AliasNode(nodes.Element):
    def __init__(
        self,
        sig: str,
        aliasOptions: dict[str, bool],
        document: Any,
        env: BuildEnvironment | None = None,
        parentKey: LookupKey | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.sig = sig
        self.aliasOptions = aliasOptions
        self.document = document
        if env is not None:
            if env.current_document.c_parent_symbol is None:
                root = env.domaindata['c']['root_symbol']
                env.current_document.c_parent_symbol = root
                env.ref_context['c:parent_key'] = root.get_lookup_key()
            self.parentKey = env.ref_context['c:parent_key']
        else:
            assert parentKey is not None

self.parentKey = parentKey

    def copy(self) -> AliasNode:
        return self.__class__(
            self.sig,
            self.aliasOptions,
            self.document,
            env=None,
            parentKey=self.parentKey,
        )


class AliasTransform(SphinxTransform):
    default_priority = ReferencesResolver.default_priority - 1

    def _render_symbol(
        self,
        s: Symbol,
        maxdepth: int,
        skip_this: bool,
        alias_options: dict[str, bool],
        render_options: dict[str, bool],
        document: Any,
    ) -> list[Node]:
        if maxdepth == 0:
            recurse = True
        elif maxdepth == 1:
            recurse = False
        else:
            maxdepth -= 1
            recurse = True

        nodes: list[Node] = []
        if not skip_this:
            signode = addnodes.desc_signature('', '')
            nodes.append(signode)
            s.declaration.describe_signature(
                signode, 'markName', self.env, render_options
            )

        if recurse:
            if skip_this:
                child_container: list[Node] | addnodes.desc = nodes
            else:
                content = addnodes.desc_content()
                desc = addnodes.desc()
                content.append(desc)
                desc.document = document
                desc['domain'] = 'c'
                # 'desctype' is a backwards compatible attribute
                desc['objtype'] = desc['desctype'] = 'alias'
                desc['no-index'] = True
                child_container = desc

            for s_child in s.children:
                if s_child.declaration is None:
                    continue
                child_nodes = self._render_symbol(
                    s_child,
                    maxdepth=maxdepth,
                    skip_this=False,
                    alias_options=alias_options,
                    render_options=render_options,
                    document=document,
                )
                child_container.extend(child_nodes)

            if not skip_this and len(desc.children) != 0:
                nodes.append(content)
        return nodes

    def apply(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        for node in self.document.findall(AliasNode):
            sig = node.sig
            parent_key = node.parentKey
            try:
                parser = DefinitionParser(sig, location=node, config=self.config)
                name = parser.parse_xref_object()
            except DefinitionError as e:
                logger.warning(e, location=node)
                name = None

            if name is None:
                # could not be parsed, so stop here
                signode = addnodes.desc_signature(sig, '')
                signode.clear()
                signode += addnodes.desc_name(sig, sig)
                node.replace_self(signode)
                continue

            root_symbol: Symbol = self.env.domains.c_domain.data['root_symbol']
            parent_symbol: Symbol | None = root_symbol.direct_lookup(parent_key)
            if not parent_symbol:
                logger.debug('Target: %s', sig)
                logger.debug('ParentKey: %s', parent_key)
                logger.debug(root_symbol.dump(1))
            assert parent_symbol  # should be there

            s = parent_symbol.find_declaration(
                name, 'any', matchSelf=True, recurseInAnon=True
            )
            if s is None:
                signode = addnodes.desc_signature(sig, '')
                node.append(signode)
                signode.clear()
                signode += addnodes.desc_name(sig, sig)

                logger.warning(
                    "Could not find C declaration for alias '%s'.", name, location=node
                )
                node.replace_self(signode)
                continue
            # Declarations like .. var:: int Missing::var
            # may introduce symbols without declarations.
            # But if we skip the root then it is ok to start recursion from it.
            if not node.aliasOptions['noroot'] and s.declaration is None:
                signode = addnodes.desc_signature(sig, '')
                node.append(signode)
                signode.clear()
                signode += addnodes.desc_name(sig, sig)

                logger.warning(
                    "Can not render C declaration for alias '%s'. No such declaration.",
                    name,
                    location=node,
                )
                node.replace_self(signode)
                continue

            nodes = self._render_symbol(
                s,
                maxdepth=node.aliasOptions['maxdepth'],
                skip_this=node.aliasOptions['noroot'],
                alias_options=node.aliasOptions,
                render_options={},
                document=node.document,
            )
            node.replace_self(nodes)


class CAliasObject(ObjectDescription[str]):
    option_spec: ClassVar[OptionSpec] = {
        'maxdepth': directives.nonnegative_int,
        'noroot': directives.flag,
    }

    def run(self) -> list[Node]:
        """On purpose this doesn't call the ObjectDescription version, but is based on it.
        Each alias signature may expand into multiple real signatures if 'noroot'.
        The code is therefore based on the ObjectDescription version.
        """
        if ':' in self.name:
            self.domain, _, self.objtype = self.name.partition(':')
        else:
            self.domain, self.objtype = '', self.name

        node = addnodes.desc()
        node.document = self.state.document
        node['domain'] = self.domain
        # 'desctype' is a backwards compatible attribute
        node['objtype'] = node['desctype'] = self.objtype
        node['no-index'] = True

        self.names: list[str] = []
        alias_options = {
            'maxdepth': self.options.get('maxdepth', 1),
            'noroot': 'noroot' in self.options,
        }
        if alias_options['noroot'] and alias_options['maxdepth'] == 1:
            logger.warning(
                'Error in C alias declaration.'
                " Requested 'noroot' but 'maxdepth' 1."
                ' When skipping the root declaration,'
                " need 'maxdepth' 0 for infinite or at least 2.",
                location=self.get_location(),
            )
        for sig in self.get_signatures():
            node.append(
                AliasNode(sig, alias_options, self.state.document, env=self.env)
            )
        return [node]


class CXRefRole(XRefRole):
    def process_link(
        self,
        env: BuildEnvironment,
        refnode: Element,
        has_explicit_title: bool,
        title: str,
        target: str,
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        refnode.attributes.update(env.ref_context)

        if not has_explicit_title:
            # major hax: replace anon names via simple string manipulation.
            # Can this actually fail?
            title = anon_identifier_re.sub('[anonymous]', str(title))

        if not has_explicit_title:
            target = target.lstrip('~')  # only has a meaning for the title
            # if the first character is a tilde, don't display the module/class
            # parts of the contents
            if title[0:1] == '~':
                title = title[1:]
                dot = title.rfind('.')
                if dot != -1:
                    title = title[dot + 1 :]
        return title, target


class CExprRole(SphinxRole):
    def __init__(self, asCode: bool) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        if asCode:
            # render the expression as inline code
            self.class_type = 'c-expr'
        else:
            # render the expression as inline text
            self.class_type = 'c-texpr'

    def run(self) -> tuple[list[Node], list[system_message]]:
        text = self.text.replace('\n', ' ')
        parser = DefinitionParser(
            text, location=self.get_location(), config=self.config
        )
        # attempt to mimic XRefRole classes, except that...
        try:
            ast = parser.parse_expression()
        except DefinitionError as ex:
            logger.warning(
                'Unparseable C expression: %r\n%s',
                text,
                ex,
                location=self.get_location(),
            )
            # see below
            node = addnodes.desc_inline('c', text, text, classes=[self.class_type])
            return [node], []
        parent_symbol = self.env.current_document.c_parent_symbol
        if parent_symbol is None:
            parent_symbol = self.env.domaindata['c']['root_symbol']
        # ...most if not all of these classes should really apply to the individual references,
        # not the container node
        signode = addnodes.desc_inline('c', classes=[self.class_type])
        ast.describe_signature(signode, 'markType', self.env, parent_symbol)
        return [signode], []

def split_warnings(warning: StringIO) -> list[str]:
    ws = warning.getvalue().split('\n')
    assert len(ws) >= 1
    assert ws[-1] == ''
    return ws[:-1]


def filter_warnings(warning: StringIO, file: str) -> list[str]:
    lines = split_warnings(warning)
    res = [
        l
        for l in lines
        if 'domain-c' in l
        and f'{file}.rst' in l
        and "WARNING: document isn't included in any toctree" not in l
    ]
    print(f"Filtered warnings for file '{file}':")
    for w in res:
        print(w)
    return res


def extract_role_links(app, filename):
    t = (app.outdir / filename).read_text(encoding='utf8')
    lis = [l for l in t.split('\n') if l.startswith('<li')]
    entries = []
    for l in lis:
        li = ET.fromstring(l)  # NoQA: S314  # using known data in tests
        a_list = list(li.iter('a'))
        assert len(a_list) == 1
        a = a_list[0]
        target = a.attrib['href'].lstrip('#')
        title = a.attrib['title']
        assert len(a) == 1
        code = a[0]
        assert code.tag == 'code'
        text = ''.join(code.itertext())
        entries.append((target, title, text))
    return entries

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Multiple id generation schemes are used due to backwards compatibility.
- v1: 1.2.3 <= version < 1.3

- v2: 1.3 <= version < now

      https://itanium-cxx-abi.github.io/cxx-abi/abi.html#mangling
      though not completely implemented.

the index. All of the versions should work as permalinks.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Each signature is in a desc_signature node, where all children are
desc_signature_line nodes. Each of these lines will have the attribute
'sphinx_line_type' set to one of the following (prioritized):
- 'declarator', if the line contains the name of the declared object.
- 'templateParams', if the line starts a template parameter list,
- 'templateParams', if the line has template parameters

- 'templateIntroduction, if the line is on the form 'conceptName{...}'
No other desc_signature nodes should exist (so far).

----------------------------------------------------------------------------

See https://www.nongnu.org/hcb/ for the grammar,
and https://github.com/cplusplus/draft/blob/master/source/grammar.tex,
and https://github.com/cplusplus/concepts-ts
for the newest grammar.

    template-parameter-list ->

    template-parameter ->

        if type_ == 'decltype(auto)':

        id_ = type_.replace(' ', '-').replace('long', 'l')
